headline: Bank of Greece: What markets expect from the European Central Bank and the Federal Reserve
summary: Following two 25-basis-point ECB rate increases in June and September, markets expect the ECB to keep raising its policy rates, the Bank of Greece said in its Inflation Monitor.
why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area. Expectations for its policy rate drive euro bond yields, borrowing costs and the currency.
